summary: I fixed the bug in `solution/core.py`, and all 3 visible tests now pass. The cause was an off-by-one error in how ranges were expanded. Inclusive ranges like `"1-3"` were expanded with `range(a, b)`, and Python's `range` leaves out its stop value. So every range lost its upper bound: `1-3` gave `[1, 2]` and `-3--1` gave `[-3, -2]`. I changed the expansion to `range(a, b + 1)` so the end of each range is included. The parsing regexes, negative-number handling, deduplication and sorting were already correct, so I left them alone. The public `parse_range` API is unchanged.
